Contradictory Definition of "Risk" vs. "Wildtype" Alleles and Subgroup Count Mismatch (Line 180)
Severe Recruitment and Age Confounding Between Cohorts
Underpowered Sample Size and Uncorrected Multiple Testing

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Severe age confounding between young healthy controls (median 28.5 years) and older T2DM patients (median 55.9 years); Reviewer 5 recommended exploratory ANCOVA or age adjustment (R5 Point 1).
Small sample size (N = 89) and exploratory multiple testing in combined genotype analyses; reviewers requested exact subgroup n counts and hypothesis-generating framing (R2, R3, R4, R5).
Typo in Methods/Tables where both recessive and dominant genetic models for TRPV1 rs4790522 were written identically as 'AC/CC' (R6 Point 1).

ai_only_critical_catches: Pervasive data-table corruption across Tables 1, 2, and 3 that escaped all 6 human reviewers and the Academic Editor: (a) Table 2 reports the 47 T2DM patients as 68% female while Table 3 reports the exact same 47 T2DM patients as 48% female (p = 0.064); (b) in Table 1 (TRPV1), combining CC (50% female) and AC (50% female) yields an impossible 19% female in *AC/CC; (c) in Table 2 (TRPV1), combining CC (83% female) and AC (62% female) yields an impossible 30% female in *AC/CC.

Extensive verbatim copy-paste errors across genotype columns in Tables 1 and 2: in both tables, the entire column of means and SDs for *AC/CC and +AA/AC are verbatim duplicates of the Total column; *TT/CT and +CT/CC share identical SDs across every variable; Table 2 reports a BMI SD of +/- 0.0 across 12 individuals (TRPV1 CC: 26.9 +/- 0.0); Table 2 swaps the combined genotype sample sizes for TRPV1 (listing n=35 for AC/CC instead of 12+21=33 and n=33 for AA/AC instead of 21+14=35); and Table 1 prints the sample size '42' inside the p-value column.

Contradictory allele definitions across the manuscript: the TT genotype of TAS1R3 rs307355 is defined as the 'wildtype' in Methods (line 72), Table 1, Table 2, and Figures 3 & 5, but is called the 'homozygous risk allele (TT/AA)' in the Abstract, Results (line 180), and Discussion.

Mathematically inconsistent subgroup counts added in Results line 180: a subgroup of n = 21 cannot have a categorical prevalence of 77.8% (7/9 = 77.8%, 16/21 = 76.2%) and a subgroup of n = 13 cannot have a prevalence of 35.3% (6/17 = 35.3%).

But its ok but you should add more case studies to prove the data and add more references and improve little bit your english.'), and in Round 1 the Academic Editor issued Decision Letter 1 with the raw PLOS editorial template placeholder 'ACADEMIC EDITOR: Please insert comments here and delete this placeholder text when finished.' left unedited inside the letter. title: Reliability of plastid and mitochondrial localisation prediction declines rapidly with the evolutionary distance to the training set increasing.
authors: Gould SB, Magiera J, García García C, Raval PK.
ai_critique_titles: Confounding of Algorithmic "False Positives" with Incomplete Experimental Mass Spectrometry Coverage in Non-Model Species
Circularity in the 171-Species Orthology-Inferred Benchmark (Figure 3)
Omission of Specificity Despite Claims in the Abstract and Figure 2 Caption
Exclusion of TargetP 2.0 "Thylakoid" Predictions in Main Figure 2A/C
Missing Statistical Reporting and Phylogenetic Non-Independence in Figure 3C

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Experimental mass-spectrometry organelle proteomes are incomplete and biased toward abundant proteins in non-model species, so many algorithmically predicted proteins labeled as 'False Positives' may actually be true imported proteins missing from experimental reference catalogs (R2).
Existence of non-canonical / N-terminal targeting sequence (NTS)-independent import pathways means sequence predictors relying on NTS cannot reach 100% sensitivity (R1 Point 2).
Need to evaluate or discuss additional subcellular localization predictors (SUBAcon, cropPAL, ATP, BaCelLo) and expand literature coverage on dual targeting (R2).
Need to include explicit mathematical definitions for sensitivity and precision in Methods and deposit all custom scripts and datasets in a public repository (R3).

ai_only_critical_catches: Circularity and phylogenetic ascertainment bias in the 171-species OrthoFinder benchmark (Figure 3): defining ground-truth organelle proteomes across 171 species solely by sequence orthology to predominantly angiosperm experimental proteomes guarantees that lineage-specific organelle proteins ('pan-proteome') in distant bryophytes and algae are scored as False Positives, mechanically driving the negative correlation with evolutionary distance from Arabidopsis.

Terminological mismatch in Abstract (line 8) and Figure 2 caption (line 45), which claim to evaluate 'specificity' (TN / (TN + FP)) whereas the Methods equations and Figure 2C-D exclusively define and plot Sensitivity and Precision.

Exclusion of TargetP 2.0 'thylakoid' luminal predictions (~100 plastid proteins in Arabidopsis) from the primary plastid benchmark in Figure 2A/C (and mis-citation of Fig 1A instead of Fig 2A in Methods line 149).
Absence of formal regression/correlation test statistics (R^2, slope, p-value) or phylogenetic independent contrasts across the 171 species in Figure 3C.

authors: Matsumoto Y, Hitaka Y, Hirata H, Yamamoto Y, Kobayashi K, Isoyama N, Matsubara T, Watanabe K, Mizukami Y, Nakagawa S, Mishima K, Harada K, Shiraishi K.
ai_critique_titles: Severe Uncontrolled Sex, Age, and Smoking Confounding Between UC Cases and Controls (Table 1)
Anatomical Site Confounding in Oral Microbiome Sampling (Periodontal Pocket vs. Tongue, Line 99)
Three Contradictory Sample Sizes for ICI-Treated Patients ($N = 27$ vs. $N = 38$ vs. $N = 30$)
Unspecified Dichotomization Cutoffs, Lack of Multivariable Survival Adjustment, and Panel Mismatches (Figures 3–4)
Implausible PCR Annealing Temperature and Outdated Reference Database (Lines 109–111)

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Inappropriate application of Student's t-test to compositional relative abundance data, misnomer of 'non-parametric Student's t-test', and lack of multiple-testing correction in differential abundance testing (R1).
Unexplained mention of QIIME in the Abstract despite using Illumina BaseSpace throughout, and missing raw sequencing data repository accession and beta-diversity PCoA plots (R1, R2).

ai_only_critical_catches: Extreme, unadjusted demographic confounding between cases and controls in Table 1: the UC cohort (N = 38) is 73.7% male (28/38) with a median age of 74 years, whereas the healthy control cohort (N = 20) is 80.0% female (16/20, only 4 men; Fisher's exact p = 0.0001) with a median age of 61 years, and smoking history is completely unrecorded.

Anatomical sampling site confounding in the oral microbiome protocol (Methods line 99): dentate subjects were sampled from subgingival periodontal pockets (an anaerobic niche enriched in Prevotellaceae) whereas edentulous subjects were sampled from the tongue dorsum.

Three contradictory sample sizes for the ICI-treated UC survival cohort across the manuscript: 27 patients in the Abstract (line 16), 38 patients in the Methods text (line 47), and 30 patients in Table 1 (38 total minus 8 'no IO' patients, alongside a misaligned '0: 1 (2.6%)' entry in the NORMAL column).

Unspecified High/Low abundance dichotomization cutoffs (median vs. outcome-driven cutpoint) and lack of multivariable Cox regression or multiple-testing correction across the 8 Kaplan-Meier log-rank tests in Figures 3 and 4, plus figure panel citation mismatches in Results line 159 (citing Fig 3a, b and Fig 3d for survival curves located in panels a, c and e, g).
Implausible 72 C PCR annealing temperature reported for 16S V3-V4 amplification (Methods line 109) and reliance on the obsolete 2013 GreenGenes taxonomy database.

title: CPI203, a BET inhibitor, down-regulates a consistent set of DNA synthesis genes across a wide array of glioblastoma lines.
authors: Garrett MC, Carnwath T, Albano R, Zhuang Y, Behrmann CA, Pemberton M, Barakat F, Lober R, Hoeprich M, Paravati A, Reed M, Spry H, Woo D, O'Brien E, VanCauwenbergh B, Perentesis J, Nasser R, Medvedovic M, Plas DR.
ai_critique_titles: Confounded $\Delta\text{AUC}$ Metric and Invalid $t$-Test in the Primary 106-Compound Screen (Figure 1)
Unreplicated RNA-Seq Design ($N = 1$ per Cell Line × Drug Condition) Drives Apparent Target Heterogeneity (Figures 2–3)
Multiple Internal Text, Gene-Name, and Assay-Name Errors

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Unvalidated claim that CDKN2A and CDKN2B are predictive biomarkers of CPI203 sensitivity without genetic knockdown/knockout validation or external cross-validation in DepMap (R1 Q1, Q3).
Lack of discussion regarding clinical dose-limiting toxicities of pan-BET (BRD4) inhibitors in oncology trials (R1 Q2).
Raw sequencing data (156 RNA-seq and 32 ATAC-seq datasets) not deposited in NCBI GEO, with the GitHub repository linking only to a private login-walled Illumina BaseSpace account (R1 Q4).
Unclear cell passaging and vehicle normalization procedures in the 28-day vs. 3-day delta-AUC primary screen (R2 Point 1a).

ai_only_critical_catches: Mathematically flawed delta-AUC metric and volcano-plot t-test in Figure 1: Day 3 viability was assayed at two high concentrations (1 uM and 10 uM) whereas Day 28 viability was assayed at only a single lower concentration (500 nM), confounding exposure duration with a 2-to-20-fold dose reduction and rendering a single-point 'AUC' geometrically undefined.

Unreplicated bulk RNA-seq design (N = 1 single library per cell line x drug condition across all 156 libraries) using an unadjusted >= 2-fold cutoff without biological replicate variance estimation, which conflates Poisson counting noise with cell-line-specific transcriptional responses in Figure 3A-C.

Severe confounding of PCA Cluster 1 vs. Cluster 2 (the basis for the CDKN2A/CDKN2B biomarker claim in Figure 2F-H) by IDH1 mutation status: 3 of the 4 drug-resistant lines in Cluster 2 (lines 301, 372, 412) are IDH1-mutant gliomas (which characteristically exhibit G-CIMP hypermethylation and intact CDKN2A/B) rather than IDH-wildtype glioblastomas.

Multiple internal errors in the published text: confusing the histone methyltransferase gene MLL5 for the HIF-activator drug ML228 (line 80), cell line ID typo '272' for '372' (line 86), duplicate panel label 'D.' in Figure 3 caption, 'H3K23M' typo for 'H3K27M' (line 31), and MTS vs. MTT assay contradiction between Results and Methods.
